title: Item: the type registry builds any class (View first)

message.text: Live: /live/div-test/ shows a div saying "Hello world". View is registered in Item.js, and a {"type":"View"} line stays a plain Item named View, so it saves back unchanged. Item.foreign builds the View when the page draws it. Proof is in the task folder (view-type/div-test-after.png).
